annotations.title: NY SLU % for a joint replacement

description: The schedule loss of use percentage for a shoulder, hip or knee replacement on its own scoring track (2018 NY Impairment Guidelines Tables 5.5 / 6.5 / 7.5, as the app's engine encodes them): the base, plus the value that most closely matches the deficit in each column (range of motion, position, atrophy, chronic complications), up to the table maximum. A failed replacement is reported as not schedulable. Shoulder takes flexion/abduction; hip takes flexion, leg-length discrepancy, mal-rotation, hip_fracture; knee takes flexion, extension contracture, malalignment, ML laxity, AP motion, leg length. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.

atrophy_inches.description: Atrophy, inches (mid-arm for the shoulder, mid-thigh for hip/knee).

hip_fracture.description: Hip: the replacement followed a fracture.

leg_length_discrepancy_inches.description: Hip or knee: leg-length discrepancy, inches.

months_post_op.description: Months since the replacement (the engine warns under its minimum).
